name: Cua Driver
summary: See when an agent drives your Mac, and stop it
description:
Cua Driver shows when a coding agent is driving your Mac through cua-driver. While a session is active, a live activity sits beside the notch with the session's name.

The shelf widget lists every session the driver is running, how recently each one acted, and a Stop button for each. Stop all revokes every session at once. Stopping is deny-only: it ends a session and can never grant one.

Needs cua-driver running on this Mac (cua-driver serve).
